name: 25701 · Huntington, WV
findings: ZIP 25701 (Huntington) has 172 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25701 (Huntington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 25701 (Huntington) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).
